issues.legal_issue: A landlord who recovers premises under a decree based on intended personal occupation or construction must take the corresponding step within one month, and an original tenant who applies within the prescribed period may recover possession if the landlord fails to do so.
material_facts: The landlord obtained a decree for possession of part of a plot on the ground that he reasonably and bona fide required it for his own occupation; the alternative ground of construction was rejected.
The landlord recovered possession but did not occupy the plot until more than one month later, when he used it to store materials for a business.
The original tenants applied to recover possession within thirteen months of the landlord recovering it.
The lower appellate court ordered possession restored to the tenants, and the High Court dismissed the landlord’s revision application.
issues.conclusion: The one-month requirement applies to decrees based on either personal occupation or construction. Because the landlord did not occupy the premises within one month, the tenants were entitled to an order for possession; the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 17(1) of the Bombay Rents, Hotel and Lodging House Rates Control Act, 1947 distinguishes recovery of possession from subsequent occupation and applies the one-month period to occupation under section 13(1)(g) as well as commencement of construction under section 13(1)(i). Its grammar and scheme protect tenants evicted on either ground, and section 17(2), which provides a penalty for non-compliance without reasonable excuse, supports applying the same period to both. No earlier cases are relied on in the judgment.

rule.if: tenant_sought_recovery_after_eviction and landlord_recovered_possession and landlord_failed_to_occupy_or_start_construction_within_one_month and tenant_applied_within_thirteen_months

predicates.tenant_sought_recovery_after_eviction: An original tenant sought return of premises after being evicted under a decree based on the landlord’s intended personal occupation or construction.
predicates.landlord_recovered_possession: The landlord obtained possession of the premises under the eviction decree.
predicates.landlord_failed_to_occupy_or_start_const: The landlord did not occupy the premises, or did not commence the intended construction, within one month after recovering possession.
predicates.tenant_applied_within_thirteen_months: The original tenant applied to recover possession within thirteen months after the landlord recovered it.

issues.definition: When an original tenant applies in time after eviction, the landlord’s failure to occupy or commence construction within the required month means the former tenant is entitled to recover possession.
